en: Black‑and‑white image of a tree‑lined stone approach to a fortified gatehouse. A large, old tree with spreading branches dominates the foreground at left, overhanging a cobbled path and low stone parapet that lead to an arched entrance in a thick stone wall. Beyond the arch is a heavy wooden door; the masonry appears medieval. On the right in the distance there is a half‑timbered building visible through the mist, suggesting a historic European castle or town fortification. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
